value.rationale: The finite-variance hypothesis of the motivating nonlinear nonsense-correlation theorem is a natural barrier. This result proves the effect persists even without finite first moments, a regime where usual unconditional population distance covariance can be undefined; stable-integral nondegeneracy and permutation-test failure supply informative structural content.
